title: dexe_agents_fund previews, caps and budgets before it will move anything
notes: 0.32.0 hardening of the one tool in the server that exists to MOVE VALUE to autonomous hot keys. NEVER add confirm:true to this scenario. dryRun:true is the belt-and-braces ("never broadcasts, even with confirm"), and the hygiene test enforces it — safety must rest on a flag that is PRESENT, not on one that happens to be absent. source:'funder' is mandatory here: the orchestrator spawns the MCP with DEXE_PRIVATE_KEY blanked, so without a source the tool refuses with "Funding requires a source wallet" and the scenario would pass for the wrong reason. `agents:['agent8']` targets the Expert/Applicant wallet, whose preflight floor is 0.002 BNB — well under the 0.09 target, so the plan is non-empty. If every targeted agent already holds the target amount the tool returns the "already meets the target" shape with no `mode`, and step 1's first assertion is what makes that visible instead of silently green.

steps.comment: 100 native > the 0.1 default cap. The refusal must name the env var so the operator knows the knob.

successCriteria.check: no txHash in the state log for this scenario
overCap names DEXE_AGENT_FUND_MAX_WEI and the per-agent cap
both the preview and the ledger report the rolling 24h budget for chain 97
